correctness.rationale: The code has an injective seven-dimensional generator realization with 63 distinct columns and 32 duplications. For any r-subcode, zero coordinates are precisely those columns in its (7-r)-dimensional message annihilator. Unique RREF enumeration covers all Gaussian binomial numbers through 11811 and computes both maxima and numbers of maximizers. A second direct union-of-codeword-supports enumeration of all r-spaces gives identical complete support histograms for both normal types; the packaged verifier returns VERIFY_OK. All quantifiers and boundary ranks 1 and 7 are covered; no infinite inference is drawn.

value.rationale: A naturally singled-out first example in a new 2026 two-class code construction is now characterized by all seven GHW values and complete counts of extremal subcodes. Higher supports measure multi-message erasure coverage and wiretap leakage, and cannot be reconstructed merely from the ordinary weight enumerator. The two code types diverge in d1/d2 but coincide from d3 onward while having different ranks of extremizers. The result is a complete, finite and non-arbitrary two-orbit benchmark; no unsupported infinite theorem or global bound is inferred.
